## Setup

## CRSP/FRB crosswalk panel (PERMCO → RSSD by quarter)

```{r}
rm(list = ls())

library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(fixest)
library(ggplot2)
library(here)
library(lubridate)
library(DescTools)
library(bit64)

source(here::here("code", "_common.R"))
```

```{r}

convert_crsp_frb_to_bank_qt <- function(file_path, start_date = "2000-03-31") {
  
  df <- fread(file_path)
  
  # Expand each (permco, RSSD) relationship to quarter-ends.
  df[, dt_start := ymd(dt_start)]
  df[, dt_end := ymd(dt_end)]
  
  df <- df[!is.na(dt_start) & !is.na(dt_end)]
  
  panel_start_date <- ymd(start_date)
  most_recent_qtr_end <- floor_date(Sys.Date(), "quarter") + months(3) - days(1)
  
  max_dt_end <- max(df$dt_end, na.rm = TRUE)
  df[dt_end == max_dt_end, dt_end := most_recent_qtr_end]
  
  generate_quarters <- function(start_date, end_date) {
    if (is.na(start_date) || is.na(end_date)) return(NULL)
    
    start <- max(start_date, panel_start_date)
    if (is.na(start) || start > end_date) return(NULL)
    
    quarter_starts <- seq(
      floor_date(start, "quarter"),
      floor_date(end_date, "quarter"),
      by = "3 months"
    )
    quarter_ends <- quarter_starts + months(3) - days(1)
    quarter_ends[quarter_ends >= start & quarter_ends <= end_date]
  }
  
  panel_dt <- df[, {
    qtrs <- generate_quarters(dt_start, dt_end)
    if (!is.null(qtrs) && length(qtrs) > 0) {
      .(
        name = name,
        inst_type = inst_type,
        entity = entity,
        permco = permco,
        quarter_end = qtrs
      )
    } else NULL
  }, by = .I][, -"I"]
  
  setnames(panel_dt, "entity", "RSSD")
  return(panel_dt)
}


crsp_frb <- convert_crsp_frb_to_bank_qt(
  here("data", "raw", "crsp_20220930v2.csv"),
  start_date = "2018-03-31"
)[, .(RSSD, permco, quarter_end)]
```


## Y-9C: controls + CECL day-one / equity

```{r}
y9c <- readRDS(here("data", "raw", "y9c.rds"))

y9c[, quarter_no := quarter(D_DT)]
y9c[, leverage_ratio := NULL]

# Convert YTD flows to quarterly rates (simple annualization).
qt_adjust_cols <- c("int_exp_dom_deposits", "nii", "int_exp_total", "non_int_exp", "net_income")
for (col in qt_adjust_cols) {
  eval(parse(text = paste0(
    "y9c[,", col, ":=ifelse(quarter_no==1,", col,
    "*4,ifelse(quarter_no==2,", col,
    "*2,ifelse(quarter_no==3,", col,
    "*4/3,", col, ")))]"
  )))
}

y9c <- y9c %>%
       arrange(ID_RSSD, D_DT) %>%
       group_by(ID_RSSD) %>%
       mutate(
         asset_growth = total_assets / lag(total_assets, 4) - 1,
         # interest_expense_pct_of_assets = int_exp_total/total_assets,
         deposit_exp_deposits = int_exp_dom_deposits / domestic_deposits,
         loans_assets = (total_loans + lag(total_loans, 1)) / (total_assets + lag(total_assets, 1)),
         nii_pct_of_assets = nii / total_assets,
         non_interest_exp_assets = non_int_exp / total_assets,
         roe_pct_quarterly = net_income / total_equity_capital,
         .groups = "drop"
       ) %>% data.table()

```


```{r}
# One CECL observation per bank (first non-missing CECL).
cecl_df <- y9c[!is.na(CECL)]
setorder(cecl_df, ID_RSSD, D_DT)

cecl_df <- cecl_df[!duplicated(cecl_df[, .(ID_RSSD)])]
cecl_df[, cecl_equity := CECL / total_equity_capital]

cecl_df <- cecl_df[, .(ID_RSSD, cecl_equity, total_assets, D_DT)]
setnames(cecl_df, "D_DT", "first_cecl_dt")
cecl_df[, cecl_equity := Winsorize(
  cecl_equity,
  quantile(cecl_equity, probs = c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE)
)]
```


## Sanity plot: CECL distribution (large banks)

```{r}
g1 <- ggplot(cecl_df, aes(x = cecl_equity * 100)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 15, alpha = 0.75) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 3, color = "darkred") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.title = element_blank()) +
  labs(x = "CECL Day 1 Adjustment/Equity (%)", y = "Number of Banks")

# pdf(paste0("figures/large_bank_cecl_dist.pdf"),width = 6,height = 3.5)
print(g1)
```



## Market cap panel (CRSP) + event time in months

```{r}
bnk_mkt <- readRDS(here("data", "raw", "bank_mkt_data_cecl.rds"))
bnk_mkt[, data_month := as.Date(paste0(year(date), "-", month(date), "-01"))]
bnk_mkt <- bnk_mkt[, .(market_cap = max(market_cap)), by = .(permco, data_month)]
bnk_mkt[, `:=`(
  normalized_market_cap = market_cap / market_cap[data_month == min(data_month)]
), by = permco]


bnk_mkt[, quarter_end := as.Date(paste0(year(data_month), "-", 3 * quarter(data_month), "-", 
                           days_in_month(as.Date(paste0(year(data_month), "-", 3 * quarter(data_month), "-01")))))]

bnk_mkt <- merge(bnk_mkt, crsp_frb, by.x = c("permco", "quarter_end"), by.y = c("permco", "quarter_end"))
bnk_mkt <- merge(bnk_mkt, cecl_df, by.x = c("RSSD"), by.y = c("ID_RSSD"))

bnk_mkt[, months_since := (year(data_month) - year(first_cecl_dt)) * 12 + (month(data_month) - month(first_cecl_dt))]
bnk_mkt[, post := ifelse(months_since > 0, 1, 0)]
```



## Event study: market cap response

```{r}
r1 <- feols(
  normalized_market_cap ~ i(months_since, cecl_equity, ref = -1) + log(total_assets) | RSSD + data_month,
  data = bnk_mkt[abs(months_since) <= 9 & year(first_cecl_dt) <= 2021],
  vcov = ~RSSD
)

# pdf(paste0("figures/mkt_cap_listed_large.pdf"),width = 6,height = 3.5)
p1 <- make_es_plot(
  r1,
  title_str = "",
  ylab_str = "Normalized Market Cap",
  col = "dodgerblue4",
  event_var = "months_since",
  xlab_str = "Months Since CECL Adjustment",
  vline_label = "CECL Adjustment\n(Month -1)",
  vline_x = -1
)
ggsave(here("docs", "figures", "mkt_cap_large_banks_20260403.png"),
       p1, width = 4, height = 2.5, bg = "transparent")
cat("Figure saved: mkt_cap_large_banks_20260403.png\n")
print(p1)
```


## CDS panel + event study (subset with full 19-month window)

```{r}
cds <- readRDS(here("data", "raw", "bank_cds_spreads.rds"))
cw <- readRDS(here("data", "raw", "ticker_permco_rssd.rds"))

cds <- merge(cds, cw, by.x = "ticker", by.y = "TICKER")
cds[, data_month := as.Date(paste0(year(date), "-", month(date), "-01"))]
cds <- cds[
  as.numeric(PX_VOLUME) > 1000000,
  .(RSSD = RSSD_TOP, data_month, CDS_spread = RSK_BB_IMPLIED_CDS_SPREAD)
]

cds <- merge(cds, bnk_mkt, by = c("RSSD", "data_month"))

cds[, CDS_spread := Winsorize(
  CDS_spread,
  quantile(CDS_spread, probs = c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE)
), by = data_month]
```


```{r}
# Keep banks with a complete event-time window (-9..+9 = 19 months).
t <- cds[abs(months_since) <= 9 & year(first_cecl_dt) <= 2021]
t <- t[, .N, by = RSSD]

r1 <- feols(
  CDS_spread ~ i(months_since, cecl_equity, ref = -1) + log(total_assets) | RSSD + data_month,
  data = cds[abs(months_since) <= 9 & year(first_cecl_dt) <= 2021 & RSSD %in% t[N == 19]$RSSD],
  vcov = ~RSSD
)

p2 <- make_es_plot(
  r1,
  title_str = "",
  ylab_str = "CDS Spread",
  col = "dodgerblue4",
  event_var = "months_since",
  xlab_str = "Months Since CECL Adjustment",
  vline_label = "CECL Adjustment\n(Month -1)",
  vline_x = -1
)
ggsave(here("docs", "figures", "cds_spread_large_banks_20260403.png"),
       p2, width = 4, height = 2.5, bg = "transparent")
cat("Figure saved: cds_spread_large_banks_20260403.png\n")
print(p2)
```
